code.yourWidgets.insteadOfTiledash.context: Badge on a partial of yours that has the name of one of Tiledash’s: it is used instead of it.

code.yourWidgets.isOut.context: Badge on an installed partial with a newer version.

code.yourWidgets.kicker.context: Small word above the page title: the section of the sidebar the page is in.

code.yourWidgets.lockedFree.context: On a card on the Free plan: widgets and partials of your own are Pro.

code.yourWidgets.newPartial.context: Button that makes a new partial.

code.yourWidgets.newPartialText.en: A piece of template, like a header, that several of your widgets render with {line}; change it once and they all follow.
code.yourWidgets.newPartialText.context: Text on the "New partial" card after your partials.

params.line: The template line that renders a partial. Not translated.

code.yourWidgets.newWidget.context: Button that makes a new widget of your own.

code.yourWidgets.newWidgetText.en: Start from any widget: a built-in, or one of yours. It gets its own name in the widget picker.
code.yourWidgets.newWidgetText.context: Text on the "New widget" card after your widgets.

code.yourWidgets.openInCommunity.context: Button on an installed partial’s card that opens its page in the community.

code.yourWidgets.openNameInCommunity.context: Read out by screen readers for an installed partial’s picture.

params.name: The partial’s id in the community, such as "@ann/sprinkler".

code.yourWidgets.options.context: Read out by screen readers for the "…" menu button on a widget’s card.

code.yourWidgets.saved.context: Label on a card: when it was last saved, such as "Today, 10:42".

code.yourWidgets.startedEmpty.context: On a widget’s card: it wasn’t based on another widget. Its settings follow.

code.yourWidgets.tiles.context: Label on a widget’s card: which tiles use it.

code.yourWidgets.usageInstead.en: {usage}{count, plural, one {, and # {builtin} tile} other {, and # {builtin} tiles}}
code.yourWidgets.usageInstead.context: Which tiles use a widget of yours when it is used instead of a built-in: first those that picked it, then how many tiles of the built-in draw it.

params.builtin: The built-in widget’s name, such as "Light".
params.count: How many tiles of the built-in widget draw it.
params.usage: Where it is picked, such as "On 2 tiles on Home" or "Not on a tile yet".

code.yourWidgets.used.context: Label on a partial’s card: which widgets render it, such as "In Sofa lamp".

code.yourWidgets.version.context: Label on an installed partial’s card: its version, such as "1.2.0".
